svg.title: SepReformer + LTRR | detailed architecture
svg.desc: Current shared 16 kHz configuration · shape probe B=2, J=2, N=64,000 · stage indices follow Python ModuleList order
svg.text: Current shared 16 kHz configuration · shape probe B=2, J=2, N=64,000 · stage indices follow Python ModuleList order
One shared block for all speaker branches
Python output: list of J tensors
No extra LTRR at D0, D1 or D2
Four separate OutputLayer/AudioDecoder pairs; this path does not pass through LTRR
E = encoder_output [2,256,7997] supplies auxiliary masking; the main head uses E only to obtain T0.
Global = EGA → GCFN; Local = CLA → GCFN; CS = speaker attention → GCFN. All attention: 8 heads, 128 features.
Shared relative-key embedding: 4000 × 16; pos_k [500,500,16]. Local CLA kernel=65. Dropout in these blocks: 0.05.
